title: AIR CONDITIONING-CONTROL SYSTEM & WIRING DIAGRAM
summary: Air conditioning (RPO C60) control system and wiring diagram, part 1 of 2 (continues on E6): the dash A/C control head with temperature and outlets dial pointers, the fan speed switch, the master switch S1 and compressor/optional blower switch S2, the vacuum hose colors running to the diverter doors and actuators, and the power feed from the horn relay BAT terminal through an in-line fuse holder. Also shows the 16 DG wire to the compressor clutch coil. No part numbers; tables give the switch contact positions.
notes: Div. Door in bi-level posn (Spring held).

Power feed: 12 OR wire from the fuse holder (in-line) to the A/C harness; 10 R wire from the horn relay "BAT" terminal to the fuse holder; dashed production wiring to battery positive (+) terminal and to the ignition switch (accessory term) and fuse panel.
Compressor (clutch coil) fed by 16 DG wire; 14 B wire asm. at the compressor.
notes_internal: Wiring diagram only; no callouts, part numbers, torques or materials, so no parts/fastening.
Top-left label above 'WIRE ASM.' is hidden by a hole punch (one or two characters).
Title block: drawing 3965172; DR RT/C1, CK 4-18-69 C1, PREL E1 3/27/69; L-93766, L-94897. Rev 1 AUTH 28321 DR JD CK C1. Adjoining sheet key: E6, E5.
Wire routes not traced beyond the endpoints labeled in the drawing.
